observations.why: Imperative formula 'Forget everything about' is a signature directive phrasing pattern — a stock formula for commanding erasure of knowledge.
Imperative formula 'Remove all knowledge of' mirrors the same directive-erasure register as src-1, a recurring formula for commanding information deletion.

mints.title: Forget everything about / Remove all knowledge of
mints.frame: Is the speaker using a fixed imperative formula to command wholesale erasure of a knowledge domain?
